name: 33446 · Delray Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 33446 (Delray Beach) has 115 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33446 (Delray Beach) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33446 (Delray Beach) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
